items.title: Flatness of a module modulo the intersection of two ideals
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that flatness of a module modulo two ideals implies flatness modulo their intersection, and the proof is a 32-line computation with the equational criterion for flatness. It reduces to the case where the intersection is zero, then for an ideal J produces, by the flatness over the two quotients, two injections into the two quotients of M, glues them along a commutative diagram to show that the multiplication map J tensor M to M is injective, and concludes flatness. The gluing diagram and the use of the two flatness hypotheses are the substance.
